author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction: Please buy 10 shares of COST, but before you do, look at the stock page for the current price and browse through the latest news to see if there's any reason to hold off. Execute the trade after your review. Make sure to report the P/E ratio exactly as listed on the stock page.
